data.gender_notes: Vina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Vina is the name of the goddess of wine. This name is derived from the Greek word ‘oinos’, meaning wine. Vina represents the joy, abundance, and festivity associated with wine. In Christianity, Vina may symbolize the spiritual wine of the Eucharist, which brings joy and nourishment to the soul. The name Vina carries the meaning “Wine, Joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vina usually hope their child will grow to embody wine, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
